meta.summary: Hides the open-in-app pop-up and download badges; blur or hide sticker thumbnails and promo banners; hide New and animated badges
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out. **Cached capture only**: store.line.me/home/en with an iPhone UA 390x844 and www.line.me/en/ with a desktop UA were captured once (querySelectorAll counts on the saved DOM, scripts stripped); line.me/en/ refused the iPhone UA (connection closed) and later automated visits were not possible, so the store on desktop and the product pages were not inspected. `real.html` is the store home page (phone), `desktop-real.html` the line.me/en landing page.

- **Open-in-app pop-up** (LIVE, 1): `#global-universal-link-popup` inside `#popup-root` on the store (the first-term agreement popup next to it is left alone).
- **Download badges** (LIVE on line.me/en: 17 App Store, 17 Google Play, 2 hero download icons): the install buttons repeated under every product row.
- **Sticker thumbnails** choice (LIVE, 126 `.mdList01Img img` on the store home): the sticker, emoji, theme and game pictures. Blur keeps the layout; Hide leaves the names.
- **Promo banners** choice (LIVE, 2 `a.home-banner-link` in the store carousel and the `#banners` strip on line.me/en).
- **Badges** (LIVE, 5 New and 42 play-icon badges on the store home).

Class names such as `mdList01Img` are LINE's old readable component classes (stable for years, not hashed) but not guaranteed. The three original rules were kept. Not verified: sticker detail pages, search results, LINE Music and the other `*.line.me` subdomains, the logged-in store.
